# cp.uz

> cp.uz is an open Uzbek-language knowledge base for competitive programming. It publishes algorithm and data-structure lessons, archived olympiad problem statements, season calendars, and verified results of participants from Uzbekistan.

Important facts:

- cp.uz does not run online contests.
- cp.uz does not accept or judge solution submissions.
- cp.uz does not maintain a participant rating or ranking system.
- “Reyting” shown on some task pages means an estimated problem difficulty, not a participant score.
- Contest dates, medal results, and participant placements are archival information collected from cited official sources.
- Solving links lead to external judge platforms such as KEP.uz or OJ.uz.
- The primary language of the site is Uzbek written in the Latin script.

## Main sections

- [Algorithms](https://cp.uz/algo/): Uzbek lessons about algorithms, data structures, proofs, complexity, and implementations.
- [Olympiad problems](https://cp.uz/tasks/): Archived problem statements and links to external judges; cp.uz itself is not a judge.
- [Olympiad seasons](https://cp.uz/seasons/): Calendars, selection stages, participant profiles, placements, points, and medal results.
- [Learning roadmap](https://cp.uz/roadmap/): A suggested order for learning competitive programming topics.
- [Dictionary](https://cp.uz/dict/): Uzbek definitions of algorithmic and competitive-programming terminology.

## Project

- [Source repository](https://github.com/cp-uz/cp-uz): Public source code and content history.
- [Telegram community](https://t.me/cp_uz): The project’s public Telegram channel.
- [Sitemap](https://cp.uz/sitemap.xml): Complete list of indexable public pages.
